//: check-css-collisions.mjs allowlist. Every entry carries the reason it is not a bug. A new entry needs a sentence a reviewer can check, not a shrug.

collisions..nf-admin-drawer__panel: admin-material.css is the console's material pass layered deliberately on top of admin.css (its header says so); both load on every admin route, admin-material after admin.css, so the wider panel always wins.
collisions..nf-admin-row__kebab: Same pair as .nf-admin-drawer__panel: admin-material.css raises admin.css's 36px kebab to the 44px icon control on purpose, loaded after it on every admin route.
collisions..nf-dock-plus: shell-m.css is the globals.css partial that overrides nav-island.css by position (its header: 'overridden by position in the cascade rather than by a specificity race'); both are in globals.css in a fixed order, so the result never depends on navigation.
collisions..nf-dockmore__unread: Same globals.css partial pair as .nf-dock-plus: shell-m.css overrides nav-island.css by its fixed position in globals.css.
collisions..nf-drawer--left: shell-m.css overrides overlays.css's drawer width by its fixed position in globals.css (the founder's full-height drawer); both always load together, in that order.

unlayered.src/app/css/base.css: The document's own html and body rules and the tap-target pseudo-elements on .nf-link-quiet.nf-tap and .nf-numeric; base.css is first in globals.css and these are the floor every layer builds on, so they are written to hold against component padding that would shrink a 44pt target.
unlayered.src/app/css/data-saver.css: Every rule is under :root[data-save-data="on"] and switches decoration off when the member asks to save data. It must beat every layered rule by design: a component layer that re-enabled an animation would break the promise.
unlayered.src/app/css/input-bar.css: The one input bar, written as :root .nf-composer.nf-composer ... so it wins over each feature's older composer styling on purpose. The two unscoped reaches (.nf-shelf-box, .nf-ai__composer) are the same bar on search and the assistant, drawn by this sheet by design.
unlayered.src/app/css/member-kit.shared.css: Accessibility preferences only: prefers-contrast more, data-contrast=more and forced-colors. They must beat any layered component colour, which is why they are unlayered.
unlayered.src/app/css/print.css: @media print only, scoped to [data-doc-print]: it has to beat the screen rules of document.css to print the one sheet and nothing else.
unlayered.src/app/css/route-motion.css: View-transition names and the route motion custom properties on :root; view-transition-name must be set once per element whatever the component layer says, or two elements claim one name and the transition is skipped.
unlayered.src/app/css/share-card.css: The share card frame (ShareCardFrame) is rendered to an image off screen; its three reaches are clean-17.css's centred-alignment variants of the same card, which are scoped by [data-align] and win where they apply. The other card that once shared this name was renamed to nf-share-post on 13 November 2026.
unlayered.src/app/css/shell-m.css: One unlayered rule, the night drawer, rail, tab bar and dock edge under :root:not([data-theme=light]); written unlayered so it wins over chrome.css and nav-island.css in every theme order. Same component, same owner.
unlayered.src/app/css/signature-motion.css: One rule under :root[data-save-data=on] that stops the logo and story ring motion when the member saves data; it must beat the layered animations.
unlayered.src/app/css/spark.css: Two rules under data-save-data, calm and off motion that stop the header dot and the button sweep; motion preferences must beat the layered animations.
unlayered.src/app/css/status-track.css: The status track component's own sheet. agreements.css, status-shapes.css and verified-payoff.css add motion and state to the same track scoped under their own ancestors (.nf-agr-track, .nf-vtrack-still). Not yet audited property by property: listed for the lead as a candidate for @layer components.
unlayered.src/app/css/touch.css: Touch floors: 16px inputs on coarse pointers (iOS zooms below that) and the tap highlight. Must beat every layered field style by design.
unlayered.src/components/app/leaderboard/leaderboa: The leaderboard's motion companion to leaderboard.css: the same component's classes, split into two sheets by concern. Nothing outside the leaderboard uses the nf-lb names.

The leaderboard's own sheet; its reaches are its motion companion (leaderboard-motion.css), the directory's .nf-lb__scope (the same scope control, reused on purpose) and .nf-btn under .nf-lb, which is scoped. Candidate for @layer components; listed for the lead.
